title: Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes: Addition to a Custody Declaration for a Piece Long Held
content:
Clause on the addition made to the figure a custody declaration rests on under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes. It applies to a piece the chain itself sold, and its size depends on how long the customer has held it.

## Clause

Where the chain sold the piece and the customer has held it for at least ten years, one tenth (10 percent) is added. Where the chain sold the piece and the customer has held it for less than ten years, one twentieth (5 percent) is added. Where the chain did not sell the piece, nothing is added over the figure the declaration rests on.

Ten years is counted as 3650 calendar days from the date the piece was originally bought, as recorded on the registration, to the handling date. The chain sold the piece where an original sales receipt is recorded against the registration.

## Boundaries

| Chain sold the piece | Calendar days held | Added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 3650 or more | 10 percent |
| yes | 3649 or fewer | 5 percent |
| no | any | nothing |

A piece bought exactly 3650 days before the handling date has been held for at least ten years; one bought 3649 days before has not.

## Readings on a figure of 12000 USD

- Sold by the chain, held 4000 days: 13200.00 USD.
- Sold by the chain, held 1000 days: 12600.00 USD.
- Not sold by the chain, however long held: 12000.00 USD.
